White Sox Win ALDS Game 1 Behind Murakami Homer and Taylor's Save

The Chicago White Sox defeated the Cleveland Guardians 3-0 in Game 1 of the ALDS. Munetaka Murakami hit a home run, and closer Grant Taylor recorded a four-inning save. The White Sox pitching staff combined for a three-hit shutout.
